what: a DRY check of the only two validators that read this arm's receipts -- tac.candidate_seal._pf_evidence and validate_prefire_risk -- on a stub carrying exactly the fields they read. It is NOT an intent, it is not written as one, and it confers nothing: no contract, no pointer, no authorization, no timing clearance. Its only purpose is to locate the emitter refusal, by showing which gates the ddm_pc3 receipts already satisfy and which gate does not read them at all.
